subject: Next steps: Security onboarding and systems in-scope (Acme Retail)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@acmeretail.com>; Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security onboarding follow-up: intake + stakeholder map

Hi Ava / Liam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and value-of-next-steps so we can align our teams and avoid back-and-forth later.

Recap (what we heard)
- Objective: pilot Redwood Dedicated for inference on product personalization models (low-latency 75th pctile goal ~60ms).
- Primary concerns: data residency, isolation (VPC), key management, and proof points (SOC 2 + architecture review).
- Timeline: target pilot kickoff in mid-May depending on procurement and security sign-off.

Stakeholders we captured on the call (please confirm / add):
- Economic buyer: Ava Reynolds, VP Product (you)
- Security lead: Liam O'Neal, Head of Security
- Procurement / legal: TBD (you mentioned Procurement works through a central portal)
- Platform/Infra: (Acme SRE) - please provide name if different from Liam

Immediate asks / next steps (proposed owners and dates)
1) Please complete the attached initial security questionnaire (Acme_Security_Q_2026.pdf) with the points in red filled — we only need a first-pass by 2026-04-22. (Owner: Acme)
2) Confirm systems in-scope (app servers, feature store, S3 buckets) and whether a private deployment (VPC) is required. If private, confirm region preference (US-East stated). (Owner: Acme)
3) Monica will prepare a short artifact bundle we typically provide (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, and an architecture playbook). Monica: will you add the sample SOW/Docusign stub? (Owner: Redwood — Monica)
4) Procurement/Legal: please share the primary contact and any required PO/contract cadence so we can surface SOW terms early. (Owner: Acme)

Attachments in this email: Acme_Security_Q_2026.pdf (initial questionnaire template).

If you prefer, we can set a 30-minute follow-up next week to walk through the questionnaire together with Liam — saves time on clarifications.

Thanks — I’ll track owners and update HubSpot record ACME-2026-EXP-57.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Rishi — great summary. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Procurement contact: I'll loop in Procurement but the day-to-day contact is currently Jenna Park (j.par k@acmeretail.com) — she handles PO and standard contractual templates. I'll confirm if we need an executive approval for pilots >$50k.
2) Data residency: we are preferring US-East (primary) with backups in US-West.
3) Private deployment: yes, we want VPC/private control plane for the pilot.

Liam will drive the questionnaire. Could you also confirm whether Redwood supports an HSM-backed key management option? That will be important for legal/compliance.

If you want to block time, 30 minutes early next week (Wed/Thu) works for us.

Thanks —
Ava
VP Product, Acme Retail
ava.reynolds@acmeretail.com

Rishi / Monica — attaching a quick network diagram (network-diagram-v2.png) and adding a few notes inline from the questionnaire. We'll fill the full PDF and send back by COB 2026-04-21.

Inline answers (high level):
- Systems in scope: feature-store (managed S3), real-time inference cluster (K8s), analytics DB (Redshift).
- VPC required: yes. Preferred region: us-east-1.
- Key management: HSM-backed keys required for production; test/pilot can use Redwood-managed keys but must be segregated.
- Audit logs: long-term retention required (365 days) and access via secure log push to our ELK stack.

Attached: network-diagram-v2.png (png). Will follow with completed Acme_Security_Q_2026.pdf tomorrow.

—Liam

Confirmed items: 
- Region: us-east-1 (primary) with backups in us-west — noted.
- VPC/private control plane required for pilot.
- HSM for production; pilot can start with Redwood-managed keys if Acme signs the pilot SOW and approves a migration plan.
- Questionnaire: we'll expect the completed PDF by 2026-04-21; if that slips, please update us by EOD 2026-04-21.

Owners we are assigning from Redwood side: 
- Monica Patel: compliance artifact pack & SOC 2 summary (will deliver by 2026-04-20).
- Priyom Das: draft SOW and standard pilot terms (working draft by 2026-04-22).
- Rishi (me): procurement follow-up, HubSpot updates, and scheduling the pilot kickoff once artifacts + questionnaire are in.

Next actions for Acme:
1) Liam to attach completed Acme_Security_Q_2026.pdf by 2026-04-21.
2) Jenna (procurement) to confirm PO process and whether we should route a preliminary SOW for review.
3) If helpful, schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with Liam + our security engineer (Monica will share availability).

I created a placeholder DocuSign stub for the pilot SOW here: https://www.docusign.com/templates/placeholder-acme-sow — we will not send until scope is confirmed.

If this looks right, I'll lock the dates and tag the HubSpot deal.
